# Every form of GNU's m68k opcode table that the 68020 with a 68881 and a 68851, GNU as's default has and no CPU

# operands that form takes and no earlier form of the mnemonic does.
# Motorola syntax, checked against GNU as --mri.
#
#   tools/fuzz/m68k.py corpus --first --cpu 68020 --syntax mot
